sentences.en: Section A The problem of how health-care resources should be allocated or apportioned, so that they are distributed in both the most just and most efficient way, is not a new one.
sentences.zh: A节如何分配或分配保健资源,以便以最公正和最有效的方式分配保健资源,不是一个新问题。

grammar.type: 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Every health system in an economically developed society is faced with the need to decide (either formally or informally) what proportion of the community’s total resources should be spent on health-care; how resources are to be apportioned; what diseases and disabilities and which forms of treatment are to be given priority; which members of the community are to be given special consideration in respect of their health needs; and which forms of treatment are the most cost-effective.
sentences.zh: 经济发达社会的每一保健系统都面临需要决定(正式或非正式)社区总资源中应当用于保健的比例;如何分配资源;应优先考虑哪些疾病和残疾以及何种治疗形式;哪些社区成员在保健需要方面应得到特别考虑;哪些治疗形式最符合成本效益。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Section B What is new is that, from the 1950s onwards, there have been certain general changes in outlook about the finitude of resources as a whole and of health-care resources in particular, as well as more specific changes regarding the clientele of health-care resources and the cost to the community of those resources.
sentences.zh: B节的新内容是,从1950年代开始,对整个资源特别是保健资源的变化前景有某些一般变化,对保健资源客户和这些资源对社区造成的费用有更具体的变化。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Thus, in the 1950s and 1960s, there emerged an awareness in Western societies that resources for the provision of fossil fuel energy were finite and exhaustible and that the capacity of nature or the environment to sustain economic development and population was also finite.
sentences.zh: 因此,1950年代和1960年代,西方社会认识到,提供矿物燃料能源的资源是有限的,可以耗尽,自然或环境维持经济发展和人口的能力也是有限的。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In other words, we became aware of the obvious fact that there were ‘limits to growth’.
sentences.zh: 换句话说,我们意识到,显然存在着 " 增长的限度 " 。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The new consciousness that there were also severe limits to health-care resources was part of this general revelation of the obvious.
sentences.zh: 新的意识认为保健资源也受到严重限制,这是对显而易见情况的一般揭露的一部分。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Looking back, it now seems quite incredible that in the national health systems that emerged in many countries in the years immediately after the 1939-45 World War, it was assumed without question that all the basic health needs of any community could be satisfied, at least in principle; the ‘in visible hand’ of economic progress would provide.
sentences.zh: 回顾过去,现在似乎相当令人难以置信的是,在1939-45年世界大战之后的几年里,许多国家出现的国家卫生系统毫无疑问地假定,任何社区的所有基本保健需求都可以得到满足,至少原则上可以得到满足;经济进步的`明显手 ' 将提供。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Section C However, at exactly the same time as this new realization of the finite character of health-care resources was sinking in, an awareness of a contrary kind was developing in Western societies: that people have a basic right to health-care as a necessary condition of a proper human life.
sentences.zh: 然而,在这种对保健资源有限性质的新的认识正在逐渐消失的同时,西方社会也正在形成一种相反的认识:人民享有作为正常人生活必要条件的保健的基本权利。

grammar.type: 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Like education, political and legal processes and institutions, public order, communication, transport and money supply, health-care came to be seen as one of the fundamental social facilities necessary for people to exercise their other rights as autonomous human beings.
sentences.zh: 保健与教育、政治和法律程序和机构、公共秩序、通信、运输和资金供应一样,被视为人民行使作为自主人的其他权利所必需的基本社会设施之一。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: People are not in a position to exercise personal liberty and to be self-determining if they are poverty-stricken, or deprived of basic education, or do not live within a context of law and order.
sentences.zh: 如果人民遭受贫困,或被剥夺基础教育,或生活在法律和秩序的环境下,他们就无法行使人身自由,不能自我决定。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the same way, basic health-care is a condition of the exercise of autonomy.
sentences.zh: 同样,基本保健是行使自治权的条件。

grammar.type: 主干结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Section D Although the language of ‘rights’ sometimes leads to confusion, by the late 1970s it was recognized in most societies that people have a right to health-care (though there has been considerable resistance in the United Sates to the idea that there is a formal right to health-care).
sentences.zh: D节虽然`权利 ' 的语言有时会造成混乱,但到1970年代末,大多数社会都承认人民有保健权(尽管美国对有正式保健权的想法有相当大的抵制)。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It is also accepted that this right generates an obligation or duty for the state to ensure that adequate health-care resources are provided out of the public purse.
sentences.zh: 也有人认为,这项权利产生国家有义务或义务,确保从公共资金中提供足够的保健资源。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The state has no obligation to provide a health-care system itself, but to ensure that such a system is provided.
sentences.zh: 国家没有义务提供保健制度本身,而是确保提供这种制度。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Put another way, basic health-care is now recognized as a ‘public good’, rather than a ‘private good’ that one is expected to buy for oneself.
sentences.zh: 基本医疗现在被公认为是「公益物」, 而不是个人预期为自己买来的「私人」。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As the 1976 declaration of the World Health Organisation put it: ‘The enjoyment of the highest attainable standard of health is one of the fundamental rights of every human being without distinction of race, religion, political belief, economic or social condition’.
sentences.zh: 正如1976年世界卫生组织宣言指出: " 享有能达到的最高标准健康是每个人的基本权利之一,不分种族、宗教、政治信仰、经济或社会状况 " 。

grammar.type: 主干结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As has just been remarked, in a liberal society basic health is seen as one of the indispensable conditions for the exercise of personal autonomy.
sentences.zh: 正如刚才所说,在一个自由社会,基本保健被视为行使个人自治权的不可或缺的条件之一。

grammar.type: 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Section E Just at the time when it became obvious that health-care resources could not possibly meet the demands being made upon them, people were demanding that their fundamental right to health-care be satisfied by the state.
sentences.zh: E节正当保健资源显然无法满足对他们提出的要求时,人们要求国家满足他们的基本保健权利。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The second set of more specific changes that have led to the present concern about the distribution of health-care resources stems from the dramatic rise in health costs in most OECD countries, accompanied by large-scale demographic and social changes which have meant, to take one example, that elderly people are now major (and relatively very expensive) consumers of health-care resources.
sentences.zh: 引起目前对保健资源分配的关切的第二组更具体的变化,源于大多数经合组织国家保健费用急剧上升,同时伴随着大规模的人口和社会变化,例如,这意味着老年人现在是保健资源的主要(而且相对昂贵)消费者。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Thus in OECD countries as a whole, health costs increased from 3.8% of GDP in 1960 to 7% of GDP in 1980, and it has been predicted that the proportion of health costs to GDP will continue to increase.
sentences.zh: 因此,整个经合组织国家的健康费用从1960年占国内生产总值的3.8%增加到1980年占国内生产总值的7%,而且据预测,健康费用与国内生产总值的比例将继续增加。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: (In the US the current figure is about 12% of GDP, and in Australia about 7.8% of GDP.)
sentences.zh: (美国目前的数字约为国内生产总值的12%,澳大利亚约为国内生产总值的7.8%。 )

grammar.type: 主干结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As a consequence, during the 1980s a kind of doomsday scenario (analogous to similar doomsday extrapolations about energy needs and fossil fuels or about population increases) was projected by health administrators, economists and politicians.
sentences.zh: 因此,在1980年代,卫生行政人员、经济学家和政治家预测了一种末日假设(类似于末日对能源需求和化石燃料或人口增长的类似末日外推)。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In this scenario, ever-rising health costs were matched against static or declining resources.
sentences.zh: 在这种假设情况下,不断上涨的保健费用与静态或不断减少的资源相匹配。

grammar.type: 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

items.prompt: the realisation that the resources of the national health system were limited
a sharp rise in the cost of health-care.
a belief that all the health-care resources the community needed would be produced by economic growth
an acceptance of the role of the state in guaranteeing the provision of health-care
Personal liberty and independence have never been regarded as directly linked to health-care.
Health-care came to be seen as a right at about the same time that the limits of health-care resources became evident.
IN OECD countries population changes have had an impact on health-care costs in recent years.
OECD governments have consistently underestimated the level of health-care provision needed.
In most economically developed countries the elderly will to make special provision for their health-care in the future.
